svg.title: Heat-transfer PCB datums and drilling order
svg.desc: Schematic sections, not to scale. Retain copper zero and map through bottom pad clearing. After pad clearing, release to set aluminium-floor zero, add one millimeter backing and remount bottom up. Drill before first flip; repeat only for obstructed holes after top work.

g.text: BOTTOM PAD CLEARING → DRILL → FIRST FLIP → TOP HEAT TRANSFER
Schematic, not to scale. Jig XY stays fixed; drilling order is proposed and not yet physically run.
10 → coat/cure → 20: keep seating
50: drill before first flip
White bottom mask; open pads with file 20
Original bottom copper Z0 + height map
1.5 mm PCB substrate
Same tape/CA bond and jig seating.
No surface probing or remapping.
Only datum-preserving tool-length setting.
Finish pad clearing before opening holes.
Copper plane +2.50 mm
PCB underside +1.00 mm
Selected backing: 1.00 mm
Tip +0.85 mm
0.15 mm breakthrough into backing
Aluminium floor Z0; no copper map
Zero with board removed, then add backing.
Preserve jig XY. Every tool-tip move above Z0.
Clean/deburr holes → flip → coat/cure top → release → align transfer using holes
After top work: inspect holes. Repeat 50 only if obstructed; restore floor setup/backing and disable mapping.
Skip cleanup if clear. Withdraw PCB pins before CNC; never recut the four jig holes or rerun pad clearing.
